basic_info.description: Spacious, detached mid-century Midtown Terrace home with superb Pacific Ocean views. Exceptionally large lot-53 ft frontage. Gorgeous front and side gardens with mature citrus trees and herb garden, leads to the entry. Refinished hardwood floors, modern lighting. Very bright. Large living room with fireplace, picture window. The dining room has windows on 2 sides with dramatic ocean views. Updated chef's kitchen-quartz counters, tile backsplash, ample cabinetry. Stainless Samsung/Bosch appliances include a French door refrigerator freezer, gas range and microwave, and a Bosch dishwasher. 3 generous bedrooms with good closets, hardwood floors and new lighting. 2 full period tiled bathrooms on the main level. Primary suite faces rear garden. Spacious lower-level family room opening to yard, full bath and large laundry room complete this level. Huge rear yard with large sun deck, patio area, Japanese rock garden, mature foliage and sweeping views to the ocean, Two car side by side garage, storage. Ideal location adjacent to Summit Reservoir, Midtown Terrace Playground and Sutro Recreation Center, close to fantastic green spaces, and all the shopping, dining and entertainment in West Portal, Cole Valley and Upper Market Street. Just blocks to MUNI bus route to Forest Hill Station
